from pathlib import Path
work=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace')

code='''from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_col = next(c for c in range(cols) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(rows)))
    left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
    frame = Counter(v for row in left for v in row if v != 0).most_common(1)[0][0]
    boundaries = [r for r, row in enumerate(left) if all(v == frame for v in row)]

    objects = {}
    seen = set()
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(sep_col, cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or color == frame or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < rows and sep_col <= nx < cols and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            y0, y1 = min(y for y, x in cells), max(y for y, x in cells)
            x0, x1 = min(x for y, x in cells), max(x for y, x in cells)
            mask = frozenset((y-y0, x-x0) for y, x in cells)
            objects[(y1-y0+1, x1-x0+1, mask)] = color

    out = [row[:] for row in left]
    for top, bottom in zip(boundaries, boundaries[1:]):
        height, width = bottom-top-1, sep_col-2
        cells = [(y, x) for y in range(top+1, bottom) for x in range(1, sep_col-1)
                 if left[y][x] == 0]
        mask = frozenset((y-(top+1), x-1) for y, x in cells)
        color = objects[(height, width, mask)]
        for y, x in cells:
            out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''

def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(sep_col, cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or color == frame or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < rows and sep_col <= nx < cols and

                        seen.add((ny, nx))

            y0, y1 = min(y for y, x in cells), max(y for y, x in cells)
